## User problem

Describe a specific workflow and who encounters the problem.

## Proposed behavior

Which existing command, hook, tool, installer, or skill should change? Include an
input/output example and explain why the current surface cannot cover it.

## Boundaries and validation

What configuration, filesystem, provider, or network access would be needed?
How would a reviewer verify success and unsafe-input behavior? Describe platform
limits and alternatives. Do not include secrets or private project data.
